name: claude-harnesses
description: Curated hooks, skills, MCP recipes, and slash commands for long-running, safe, high-quality Claude Code-driven development.

plugins.name: full
plugins.description: Everything at once: every skill, command, agent, and hook from all packs. Install this or individual packs, not both.

plugins.name: adviser-pack
plugins.description: Fallback Adviser consultations using a review-only Opus subagent when the native Advisor tool is unavailable.

plugins.name: review-pack
plugins.description: Severity-ranked code review and multi-pass security review with parallel specialist subagents.

plugins.name: pr-guardian-pack
plugins.description: Watch PRs after creation: monitor CI, dispatch fixes via subagents, address review feedback.

plugins.name: tdd-pack
plugins.description: Red-Green-Refactor TDD with subagent context isolation between phases.

plugins.name: safety-pack
plugins.description: Deterministic PreToolUse guards: secret detection, dangerous commands, branch protection, prompt injection, MCP allowlisting.

plugins.name: verification-pack
plugins.description: Verification feedback loop: format/typecheck/test on every edit, and block premature Stop until verify.sh passes.

plugins.name: long-running-pack
plugins.description: Survive context loss across sessions: SessionStart context injection, cost-ceiling guard, large-edit gate, ledger templates, goal-manager workflow.

plugins.name: mcp-pack
plugins.description: Curated .mcp.json recipe for GitHub, Playwright, Context7, Serena, Sequential-Thinking, Sentry, and Excalidraw. All servers ship disabled.

plugins.name: product-pack
plugins.description: Product-quality workflows for frontend design, image-guided UI direction, kaizen evaluation loops, and merge-ready implementation delivery.

plugins.name: research-pack
plugins.description: Research helpers for reading public web pages that normal browsing, scraping, snippets, or direct fetch tools cannot read cleanly.

plugins.name: meta-pack
plugins.description: Inspect recent Claude Code activity and promote repeated patterns into the smallest useful Skill, subagent, or hook. Read-only investigation; creation gated by user approval.

plugins.name: teaching-pack
plugins.description: Teach the human everything that happened in a session until they can demonstrably explain it, via an incremental checklist and AskUserQuestion quizzes.

plugins.name: skill-adviser
plugins.description: Route an independent, review-only Claude process to a deterministically stronger model or effort when native Advisor is unavailable.

plugins.name: skill-bug-fix
plugins.description: Fix bugs with reproduction, minimal changes, regression coverage, and targeted verification.

plugins.name: skill-deslop
plugins.description: Remove AI-generated boilerplate (vague comments, unused try/except, defensive validation, restated docstrings) from changed code without changing behavior.

plugins.name: skill-docs-updater
plugins.description: Update documentation after code or behavior changes while keeping docs concise and relevant.

plugins.name: skill-empirical-prompt-tuning
plugins.description: Iteratively improve a skill or prompt by having a fresh subagent execute it against fixed scenarios, scoring two-sided (executor self-report + a pre-frozen requirements checklist), and looping until…

plugins.name: skill-feature-implementation
plugins.description: Implement a feature safely with planning, focused edits, tests, docs, and verification.

plugins.name: skill-finish-pr-feedback
plugins.description: Compatibility alias for pr-guardian. Use pr-guardian for stalled pull requests, CodeRabbit/Codex review feedback, CI failures, unresolved review conversations, and merge-ready PR follow-up.

plugins.name: skill-fix-ci
plugins.description: Diagnose and repair failing CI checks on the current PR by parsing logs, reproducing locally when possible, and pushing focused fixes in batches.

plugins.name: skill-frontend-design
plugins.description: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one.

plugins.name: skill-goal-manager
plugins.description: Manage durable task goals for long-running Claude Code work using the project ledger, including objective writing, success criteria, resumption, and completion decisions.

plugins.name: skill-implement-to-merge-ready
plugins.description: Run an end-to-end Claude Code delivery workflow from user request to merge-ready pull request, including planning, implementation, tests, self-review, ready-for-review PR creation, CI/review follow-u…

plugins.name: skill-jina-reader
plugins.description: Fetch public web pages with Jina AI Reader API and convert them into LLM-friendly Markdown.

plugins.name: skill-kaizen-loop
plugins.description: "Run a continuous product improvement loop: evaluate a product or codebase, present prioritized recommendations for approval, then implement only approved improvements through verification and PR fol…

plugins.name: skill-long-running-orchestrator
plugins.description: Run multi-hour or multi-session work safely by combining the ledger, checkpoints, cost-ceiling guard, and resumable progress notes so context loss does not erase progress.

plugins.name: skill-meta-packager
plugins.description: Analyze recent Claude Code work and package repeated patterns as the smallest useful skill, custom subagent, slash command, hook, or automation.

plugins.name: skill-no-slop
plugins.description: MODIFIER skill that removes AI slop from prose without losing source facts or uncertainty. Use with any writing task or to rewrite text; for code slop, use deslop instead.

plugins.name: skill-pr-guardian
plugins.description: Monitor a pull request after opening it or resume a stalled PR, fix CI failures and reviewer feedback, push updates, reply to and resolve review conversations, and comment with the outcome.

plugins.name: skill-refactor-safely
plugins.description: Refactor code without behavior changes using small mechanical steps and verification.

plugins.name: skill-release-check
plugins.description: Check whether a change is ready to release by reviewing diff, tests, docs, risks, and migration notes.

plugins.name: skill-review
plugins.description: Review code changes with a bug-first, risk-focused workflow before merge or release.

plugins.name: skill-review-briefing
plugins.description: Prepare a human reviewer to review a pull request in the least time with the best judgment.

plugins.name: skill-security-review
plugins.description: Run a multi-pass security review over the current diff using parallel specialist subagents focused on injection, authn/authz, secrets, supply-chain, and infrastructure-as-code risks.

plugins.name: skill-simplify
plugins.description: Review changed code on the current branch for reuse, clarity, and dead complexity, then propose or apply minimal cleanup without changing behavior.

plugins.name: skill-tdd
plugins.description: Drive development with red-green-refactor using isolated test-writer, implementer, and refactorer subagents so tests reflect intent rather than anticipated implementation.

plugins.name: skill-teach-session
plugins.description: Teach the human everything that happened in this session until they can demonstrably explain it, using an incremental checklist, restate-first probing, and AskUserQuestion quizzes.

plugins.name: skill-ui-imagegen-director
plugins.description: Direct high-quality frontend UI work by using image-generated mockups when useful, translating the chosen direction into code, and verifying the rendered UI in a browser.
